_about: Obselda's rig settings, read by tools/build_character.py. Parts are listed by position in the flat Figma export art/obselda/Obselda.svg (0-based, [from, to) ranges). The export has no layer names; shapeCount stops the build if it changes.
label: Obselda
_anchor: Where she stands: the centre line of her face and tunic, and her soles.
_headPivot: Under the chin, where the scarf starts: the head nods and sways about this point, and the scarf, earrings and hair move with it.

explorer.label: Explorer
explorer._body_back: Her long hair hanging down her back: behind the arms, it moves with the body's breathing.
explorer._arms: By screen side. Upper arm, hand and forearm, drawn like Skyrian's (the same capsules, 1.18 times bigger). Her hands are behind her back as drawn: that is her resting pose. Her straight pose and pivots carry over from Skyrian's arms-down drawing.

_head: The head's layers, back to front. Named layers are part files; pupils, lids, brows and mouth are the shared face rig. Her brows sit in front of her bangs (in Figma they're behind), so they stay visible when they lift.

_headOutline: Hair, ears, face, scarf and bangs get the white outline.

face._smile: Her drawn mouth (the Mouth frame). It is her idle smile, and the shared mouth shapes are scaled and centred onto it.
face._lidColors: Skin around each eye: her face is lighter on the screen-left half and darker on the right.
face._lipColor: Ring around the round mouth (F): it matches her face.
face._minStroke: Thinnest line for the rest and closed mouths (X, A) at her size, in canvas units.

_settings: Changes to tools/rig_settings.json for her only. Pupil reach is scaled to her eyes (a bigger pupil than Nova's). Full body and close-up are set (the close-up frames her face, from her bun to her scarf, for checking lip-sync); knees and waist are Nova's sizes from the top of her hair.
